source_statement: Inside an equilateral triangle of side length 6, three congruent equilateral triangles of side length x with sides parallel to the original equilateral triangle are arranged so that each has a vertex on a side of the larger triangle, and a vertex on another one of the three equilateral triangles, as shown below. A smaller equilateral triangle formed between the three congruent equilateral triangles has side length 1. Compute x.

clause_ledger.source: three congruent equilateral triangles of side x, parallel to the outer triangle
clause_ledger.dsl: T1,T2,T3 use the same downward equilateral coordinate template with side variable x

clause_ledger.source: one vertex of each small triangle lies on the large triangle
clause_ledger.dsl: U1 on AB, V2 on AC, W3 on BC with segment membership residuals

clause_ledger.source: one vertex lies on another small triangle, as shown
clause_ledger.dsl: U2 on V1W1, V3 on U2W2, and W1 on U3V3; these are the three cyclic contacts visible in the official figure

clause_ledger.source: central equilateral triangle has side length 1
clause_ledger.dsl: the three contact vertices W1,U2,V3 have all pairwise distances 1
